verdict.rationale: dlt's core function is batch operations over many records at once. It loads whole lists of records, entire SQL tables, and sets of files in one run. It also offers bulk merge/upsert with deduplication and full-load replacement of a destination dataset. Nothing shows bulk actions across many pipelines or other managed items as a single operation, so the story is only partly met. Missing for 10: bulk actions across multiple pipelines or resources, a documented batch-operation interface for agents, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: let's load a list of Python dictionaries into DuckDB and inspect the created dataset
Merge: Merges new data into the destination using merge_key and/or deduplicates/upserts new data using primary_key.
Full load: replaces the destination dataset with whatever the source produced on this run.
load data files like JSONL, CSV, and Parquet from either Cloud Storage (e.g., AWS S3, Google Cloud Storage, Google Drive, Azure Blob Storage), a remote (SFTP), or a local file system
